mapper.select: select * from store order by sno asc
select sno, sname, sfiles, scategory, skeyword, scontent, saddr, slat, slong, stel, sinfo, TO_CHAR(sdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sdate, sparking, sstatus from store where sno = #{sno}
mapper.insert:
select STORE_SEQ.NEXTVAL from dual
insert into store(sno, sname, sfiles, scategory, skeyword, scontent, saddr, slat, slong, stel, sinfo, sdate, sparking, sstatus) values(#{sno}, #{sname}, #{sfiles}, #{scategory}, #{skeyword}, #{scontent}, #{saddr}, #{slat}, #{slong}, #{stel}, #{sinfo}, TO_DATE(#{sdate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{sparking}, #{sstatus})
mapper.update: update store set sname=#{sname}, sfiles=#{sfiles}, scategory=#{scategory}, skeyword=#{skeyword}, scontent=#{scontent}, saddr=#{saddr}, slat=#{slat}, slong=#{slong}, stel=#{stel}, sinfo=#{sinfo}, sparking=#{sparking}, sstatus=#{sstatus} where sno=#{sno}
